claim: Windows ctrld v1.5.7 must run under SCM as its own Windows service; running `ctrld run` as a child of DirectInternetMethodSvc is incompatible with ctrld's Windows service lifecycle and caused START_FAIL_ULA_LISTENER_NOT_OWNED.

evidence.detail: ctrld child stayed alive but produced `failed to start service: The service process could not connect to the service controller`; no owned ULA:53 listener.
same ctrld binary registered as SCM service `ctrld` reached RUNNING; UDP+TCP 127.0.0.1:53 owned by one PID; DNS github.com resolved.
on Windows daemon mode is rejected; when not daemon, run() calls s.Run() to attach to OS service manager.

decision: Replace child-process ctrld lifecycle with an owned demand-start SCM service named `ctrld`; validate ImagePath ownership before control; preserve fail-closed behavior for external service name collisions.
rejected: Increase listener readiness timeout: disproven by 30s no-listener observation.
Move ctrld listener to another DNS port: NRPT needs DNS port 53 and would add an unnecessary front-end.
Run ctrld as ordinary interactive child: incompatible with no-UAC privileged backend/service execution model.
